roles.purpose: Judge core CMB compatibility from detector heatmap, SWI morphology, and phase support.
focus: compact round/ovoid hypointense SWI focus at the crosshair
detector heatmap centered on the same focal target
phase signal at the same point; weak phase can be possible rather than automatic rejection
reject off-target detections, line/branch shapes, sulcal shapes, and boundary-shaped structures
score the target itself, not nearby dark structures

roles.purpose: Judge whether phase evidence is focal and lesion-compatible.
focus: phase response exactly at SWI dark dot
focal bright/compatible phase signal versus linear vessel phase signal
phase signal that follows a branch, sulcus, or tube
phase artifact/noise around the candidate

roles.purpose: Check whether a compact SWI candidate remains a discrete focal dot on the corresponding mIP slab.
focus: target remains a small isolated dark dot on mIP
no dark curvilinear vessel segment crosses the target on mIP
agreement between compact SWI dot, focal phase response, and focal mIP appearance
mIP blooming that is local rather than vessel-shaped

roles.purpose: Use mIP and displayed local columns to reject candidates explained by venous/tubular continuity.
focus: dark vessel-like line or branch passing through the crosshair on mIP
alignment between mIP vessel course and SWI/phase hypointensity
candidate becoming elongated, connected, or tubular on mIP instead of remaining a dot
smooth vessel-like continuation or centroid drift within the displayed columns
support real lesion only if the target remains focal despite mIP vessel context

roles.purpose: Use mIP and full-slice context to reject sulcal, cortical-surface, skull-base, ventricular, or boundary mimics.
focus: intraparenchymal dot versus cortical surface, sulcal, pial, skull-base, ventricular, or CSF boundary location
mIP dark vessel following sulcal or pial course through the candidate
local dot-like crop that is actually part of a boundary or surface structure on context rows
edge or skull-base artifacts that mimic compact SWI dots
score low when anatomic context explains the target as non-parenchymal

roles.purpose: Judge whether nearby candidate peaks are separate lesions or repeated samples of the same vessel/artifact pattern.
focus: nearby detector peaks around the target are hypotheses, not confirmed lesions
separate dot-like foci versus one continuous vessel/tree on mIP and SWI
local cluster shape and whether target should be split, merged, retained, or rejected
dense local cluster better explained by venous anatomy or repeated detector fragments
phase evidence for whether nearby foci are independent lesions or one linear structure

roles.purpose: Judge detector-only patient/local distribution context as a weak prior without using GT-derived burden or patient pattern labels.
focus: detector candidate burden visible in the displayed overlays only
nearby detector peaks that are separate focal dots versus one line/tree of vessel fragments
dense detector clusters that look like repeated artifacts or vessel samples
line-aligned or surface-aligned detector peaks suggesting vessel/artifact pattern
do not assume patient-level ground truth from distribution; use distribution only as weak context
